Helping Indian manufacturers reach US customers

Turning export ambition into customer relationships.

The objective

Help Indian manufacturers of marble, granite and textiles develop business in the US.

Mak’s contribution

Across these assignments, Mak researched demand and pricing, developed marketing strategies, ran sales campaigns and built prospective customer relationships. He shaped and presented offers around the needs of regional retail buyers.

The outcome

The work secured ongoing purchase orders from regional chain stores.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Helping Indian businesses understand an overseas market, position their products and move from initial interest to commercial orders.

Related services

  • Adapt your offer for the market
  • Grow your market presence

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
